title: 第7章 暴打张霖黑玉灵髓第8章 完美气海叶家危机
content_zh:
青竹对苏尘也有些不满。
在她看来苏尘能够入赘叶家，成为小姐的夫君是天大的福分，但苏尘不老老实实的当赘婿，一来就惹事生非。
昨天打伤了叶陵和张坤，今日竟然又和张霖针锋相对，为小姐惹下了不少的麻烦。
不过，叶倾城让她保护好苏尘，尽管她心中不满，也不好多说什么。
“苏尘，你这个废物，赘婿当习惯了只会躲在女人的身后吗？有本事滚出来，和我打一架！
别畏畏缩缩的，不像个男人！”
张霖看了青竹一眼，眼神中有着一丝忌惮之色。
不过他还是看向苏尘冷笑道。
谁不知道，叶倾城虽然无法修炼，但手下梅兰竹菊四大侍女，都是修炼天才，修为不凡。
尤其是青竹，更是天赋超绝，擅长剑道，战力极强。
张霖没有想到，叶倾城竟然派青竹来保护苏尘，他心中充满了嫉妒，看苏尘越发的不顺眼了。
“姑爷，不要冲动，我们走！”
青竹小声地说道。
她自然能看出来，张霖这拙劣的激将法，就是想要激怒苏尘。
“青竹，你让开吧！
人家都蹬鼻子上脸了，若不应战，岂不是说我怕了他？他想打，那就打！”
苏尘淡淡的说道。
青竹心中不满苏尘的任性，但又不能当面抗命，所以还是退了下去，依旧是警惕的盯着张霖。
“苏尘，你还算个男人！
但可惜你只是一个没脑子的废物，今天我就替张坤堂弟，好好教训你一番！”

张霖冷笑了一声道。
轰！
他凌空探爪，爪芒凌厉无匹，凝聚着淡淡的真气波动，犹如闪电般朝着苏尘抓来。
金鹰爪！
这是张家的一种黄阶上品武技，加上他气武境三层的修为，威力无比强大，能够撕裂金石。
他打定了主意要给苏尘一个狠狠的教训。
“姑爷，小心！”
青竹脸色一变，就要出手。
但一股强大的气血之力却先打一步爆发，而后势如猛龙一般，一拳轰出！
咔嚓！
这一拳刚猛无匹，宛如一道闪电轰鸣，伴随着淡淡的龙威，瞬间迎上了张霖的金鹰爪。
只听见一道清脆的声音响起。
张霖的手指瞬间折断，血光弥漫，他整个人如遭雷击一般，猛然横飞了出去。
“啊……”
张霖口中惨叫，手臂发麻，眼神中满是难以置信的神色。
苏尘不是一个废物吗？
怎么可能拥有如此可怕的力量？
content_en:
Qingzhu was also a little dissatisfied with Su Chen.
In her opinion, it was a great blessing for Su Chen to join Ye's family and become the young lady's husband. However, Su Chen acted dishonestly as his son-in-law and caused trouble as soon as he came.
Yesterday, Ye Ling and Zhang Kun were injured, and today they actually had a tit-for-tat confrontation with Zhang Lin, causing a lot of trouble for the young lady.
However, Ye Qingcheng asked her to protect Su Chen. Even though she was dissatisfied, she couldn't say much.
"Su Chen, you loser, are you used to hiding behind women? If you have the ability, get out and fight with me!"
Don't be shy, you don't look like a man! "
Zhang Lin glanced at Qingzhu, with a hint of fear in his eyes.
However, he still looked at Su Chen and sneered.
Who doesn't know that although Ye Qingcheng is unable to practice, his four maids of plum, orchid, bamboo and chrysanthemum are all geniuses in cultivation and their cultivation is extraordinary.
Qingzhu, in particular, is extremely talented, good at swordsmanship, and extremely powerful in combat.
Zhang Lin did not expect that Ye Qingcheng would send Qingzhu to protect Su Chen. He was filled with jealousy, and Su Chen became more and more displeased with him.
"Uncle, don't be impulsive, let's go!"
Qingzhu said softly.
She could naturally see that Zhang Lin's clumsy provocation was just to anger Su Chen.
"Qingzhu, get out of the way!
People are kicking their noses and getting into trouble. If I don't fight, wouldn't it mean that I'm afraid of him? If he wants to fight, then fight! "
Su Chen said calmly.
Qingzhu was dissatisfied with Su Chen's willfulness, but couldn't disobey him face to face, so he retreated, still staring at Zhang Lin warily.
"Su Chen, you are still a man!
But it's a pity that you are just a brainless waste. Today, I will teach you a lesson on behalf of cousin Zhang Kun! "
Zhang Lin sneered.
boom!
He reached for his claws in the air, and the claws were extremely sharp, condensed with faint fluctuations of true energy, and they were grabbing at Su Chen like lightning.
Golden eagle claw!
This is a yellow-level high-grade martial skill from the Zhang family. Coupled with his cultivation at the third level of the Qi Martial Realm, it is extremely powerful and can tear apart gold and stone.
He made up his mind to teach Su Chen a harsh lesson.
"Uncle, be careful!"
Qingzhu's expression changed and he was about to take action.
But a powerful force of energy and blood burst out first, and then punched out like a fierce dragon!
Click!
This punch was unparalleled, like a lightning roar, accompanied by a faint dragon's power, and instantly met Zhang Lin's golden eagle claws.
Only a crisp sound was heard.
Zhang Lin's fingers were instantly broken, blood filled the air, and his whole body suddenly flew out as if struck by lightning.
"Ah..."
Zhang Lin screamed, his arms were numb, and his eyes were full of disbelief.
Isn't Su Chen a waste?
How could it be possible to possess such terrifying power?
